title: FEMBOY HAREM
description:
Welcome to Femboy Harem! 🌸✨

Step into a world filled with sweet surprises, warm friendships, and lots of love! Femboy Harem is a heartwarming visual novel set in the grand and luxurious Elysium Estate. You are the lucky guest invited to participate in "The Courtship"—a special event that will change your life! 🎀

💖 What Awaits You?

• 8 Unique Suitors: Meet 8 incredibly adorable femboys, each with their own distinct personality, hobbies, and secrets. (From our shy, talented chef Lily, to the mysterious Rose in the wine cellar!) ☁️

• A Sweet & Heartfelt Story: Uncover the hidden corners of the estate and witness the personal journeys of each character. Get swept away in a magical adventure full of unexpected moments and heart-melting dialogue. 💌

• Interaction & Discovery: Spend your days sharing moments with the characters. Join them in their favorite spots—like the music room, greenhouse, or kitchen—to strengthen your bonds. ☕

• A Cozy & Relaxing Atmosphere: Enjoy beautiful pastel visuals and soothing music as you experience little surprises that will make you smile. 🍡

If you want to take a break from the hustle and bustle of daily life and dive into a loving, cozy, and kawaii adventure, the doors of Elysium Estate are always open for you! Won't you join us? (´｡• ᵕ •｡`) ♡
description_short: You're invited to Elysium Estate! 🌸 Meet 8 incredibly adorable femboys, form heartfelt bonds, and step into a heartwarming story. Make room for love and sweet surprises in this cozy visual novel experience <3 (´｡• ᵕ •｡`)
